posts.preview: This week, I will join the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Gender Equality, Health and Social Welfare on an oversight mission to the Ohangwena and Omusati regions

Our focus is to assess HIV, Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR), and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) service delivery for adolescents and young people, identify barriers such as stigma and discrimination, and strengthen parliamentary oversight to ensure equitable, youth-friendly healthcare

By engaging with health workers, government officials, and communities, we aim to develop evidence-based recommendations that improve health services and uphold the rights and dignity of every young person in Namibia See less
